verdict.rationale: Formant documents its own data-export path: a Python Cloud SDK that queries telemetry through the query API, on a docs page titled data export. Device configuration can also be exported to YAML, an open format. Nothing shows a complete, account-wide export of all data in open formats or an offboarding path, so only part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: bulk/full-account export of all data types (video, assets, events, analytics), documented open export formats for telemetry, offboarding or account-exit guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: The primary programmatic way data scientists query for telemetry data is via the Cloud SDK, a lightweight Python module which can interact with the query API.
